fields.description: Issue includes an "inside story" on an alleged beating involving Miami Police Detective Lt. C. O. Huttoe and Chief of Detectives James Barker, with discussion of departmental conflict and misconduct allegations. Other articles criticize the Dade County Crime Commission; recount the Joseph E. Jacobson divorce/annulment dispute; report on Shandiclere Restaurant & Bar employing minors; discuss bookmaking and pari-mutuel racing economics in Dade County; preview the Dade County Coconut Harvest Festival and Luau at Crandon Park; cover justice-of-the-peace court practices and a civil-rights beating conviction; reprint a UAW-CIO labor statement; present traffic fatality cost statistics; and report a court case involving a child-molestation allegation and an assault charge.
